checkedAlternates.risk: Macaron derives historically from Italian almond maccherone.
checkedAlternates.resolution: The modern double-shell ganache-filled Macaron is an iconic Parisian French patisserie creation (group-3), not Italian (group-4).

checkedAlternates.risk: Panna cotta is a custard-like cream dessert like Crème Brûlée.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Panna cotta is a gelatin-set Piedmontese Italian cream dessert (group-4), whereas Crème Brûlée is a French baked egg custard (group-3).
